d: Jharkhand Panchayat Chunav 2027: jharkhand men panchayat chunav se pahle pichhron ke aarakshan par siyasat garma gaee hai...pharavri-march 2027 men prastavit panchayat chunav ko lekar bijepi ne tripal test pura karane aur uske bad hi pichhron ko aarakshan dekar chunav karane ki mang uthayi hai...vahin kangres aur JMM ne bijepi ki is mang par palatvar kiya hai...to dusri taraph pichhra varg aayog ke adhyaksh ne bharosa diya hai ki panchayat chunav samay par aur aarakshan ke sath honge...aise men saval hai ki panchayat chunav se pahle tripal test pura hoga? pichhron ko aarakshan milega? ya…
